Aragnya's Tale is a book found in the Grand Library of Menaphos about Aragnya and a powerful artefact called Aragnya's Veil.
It can be obtained from the third bookcase on the southern wall in the south-east corner on the bottom level (just south of the stairs).

The " ludicrous belief that the universe formed over millennia as a result of rapid heat expansion" mentioned in the tale is a reference to the real-life of how the universe came to be; in RuneScape, the universe, or at least its planets and stars, was instead created by the Elder Gods.

Crown of Loyalty XIII.x: The Crown of Loyalty XIII is an item awarded for having a continuous membership subscription for thirteen years. The first 13-year crowns were awarded on 28 May 2024 as part of the Members Loyalty Programme.

tx: The easiest way to obtain desert goat horns is to kill goats just west of the bank in Nardah, where banking is quick. It is recommended to wear full desert clothes and have two or more full waterskins in your inventory as the damage from the desert heat effect can be dangerous. An enchanted water tiara with water runes bound to it can be used in place of waterskins to save inventory space. Having a high combat level and a good weapon is recommended to kill goats quickly. If you are combat level 75+, you can bank 350-400 desert goat horns in an hour, hopping between four worlds.
sc: Desert goat horns are obtained by killing a Goat or Billy goat in the Kharidian Desert, or Scabarites (all but Scabaras ranger), or as a random drop from Corporeal Beast.
They can also be obtained from slicing open dung kalphites in the Kalphite nursery.
Diamond Suit is a cosmetic override set that can be unlocked by claiming a Diamond Suit token.

The draconic fruit is a type of Jadinko fruit that can be found in the Jadinko Lair, received through the offering stone or from Mutated jadinko drops, although getting a draconic fruit on the stone is uncommon.

tx:
Any Construction activity (in regular or building mode) that would garner Construction experience (building furniture, making flatpacks, building for construction contract, Fort Forinthry construction/reinforcing). They may also be obtained by crafting items in clockmaker's bench despite gaining crafting experience in the process. To conserve resources it is advised to build something that uses low amount of planks.
Building limestone fireplace and oak chair flatpacks gives strange rocks most quickly and for comparatively low cost, at and , respectively (assuming items are bought from the Grand Exchange). Oak lectern only requires one oak plank, but cannot be made as a flatpack. Flatpacks can also be traded in with Advisor Ghrim once all of hard Fremennik achievements have been completed, allowing some of the loss to be recouped.
Skilling in the Dream of Iaia also provides quick ticks of Construction experience and allows for obtaining both golden and regular strange rocks quickly.

Turkey book.x: The turkey book is a book that players could obtain as part of the 2008, 2014, 2015, and 2016 Thanksgiving events. It gives clues on where to find disguised turkeys around Gielinor, which players could find and spy on. Players could obtain the book from the cook's brother in Lumbridge Castle.
